patch_description: The previous implementations have repeatedly failed due to invalid contact schedules, where contacts are changed directly from one surface to another without an intermediate free state. This new approach introduces a state-based mechanism to ensure that all transitions are valid. It uses helper functions to manage the release and transition of contacts, ensuring that each contact passes through a free state before changing surfaces. This should help avoid the common issue of direct surface transitions and improve the feasibility of the generated contact plans.
